newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Uralita H1 net profit 1.553 bln ptas.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Uralita H1 net profit 1.553 bln ptas.

text.p: Six months to June results for building materials group Uralita in billions of pesetas, unless stated:
NOTE - Uralita said ordinary profit in the second quarter stood at 2.331 billion pesetas against 760 million pesetas in the first quarter.
The fall in sales was attributed to low chemical prices and the weakness of the building sector.

The firm said the start of the second half has seen some improvement, with an increase in sales. It expects this to continue for the rest of the year, both in the construction and the chemicals divisions.
Net debt fell by 2.0 billion pesetas, Uralita said.
